vulnerabilities.name: Exposed Git Repository
vulnerabilities.description:
Live .git/config served at http://127.0.0.1:19090/.git/config: full repo history downloadable

MITIGATION: Remove .git from production. Add 'RedirectMatch 404 /\.git' to web server config. Regenerate any secrets exposed in git history.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Deny /.git at the edge and purge secrets from git history.

vulnerabilities.name: Exposed Environment File (.env)
vulnerabilities.description:
Live .env file with secrets served at http://127.0.0.1:19090/.env (HTTP 200)

MITIGATION: Restrict .env access: nginx 'location ~ /\.env { deny all; }' or apache 'Files ".env" { Require all denied }'. Immediately rotate all exposed credentials.
vulnerabilities.evidence: HTTP 200, Content-Type text/plain; charset=utf-8, secrets marker: "APP_ENV=production\nDB_PASSWORD=hunter2\nSECRET_KEY=abc123"
vulnerabilities.remediation: Block dotfiles at the edge and rotate every secret in the file.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache server-status Exposed
vulnerabilities.description:
Live mod_status at http://127.0.0.1:80/server-status leaks workers, vhosts, request paths

MITIGATION: Apply vendor patches and restrict network access to the affected service.

MITIGATION: Apply vendor patches and restrict network access to the affected service.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Set HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options and frame-ancestors.

vulnerabilities.name: SQL Injection
vulnerabilities.description:
Parameter "id" injectable at http://127.0.0.1:19090/api/user?id=1

MITIGATION: Apply vendor patches and restrict network access to the affected service.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Database error signature "you have an error in your sql syntax" appeared after injection (HTTP 200 -> 500)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use parameterized queries; never concatenate input into SQL.

vulnerabilities.name: Server-Side Template Injection
vulnerabilities.description:
Template expression evaluated in "file" at http://127.0.0.1:80/server-status

MITIGATION: Apply vendor patches and restrict network access to the affected service.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Payload "<%= 7*7 %>" produced "49" while control "<%= 8*8 %>" did not produce "64"
vulnerabilities.remediation: Do not render user input as template source; use sandboxed contexts.

vulnerabilities.name: Server-Side Template Injection

vulnerabilities.remediation: Do not render user input as template source; use sandboxed contexts.
